name: Zerobyte
short_desc: Powerful backup automation for your remote storage
author: nicotsx
description: Zerobyte is a backup automation tool that helps you save your data across multiple storage backends. Built on top of Restic, it provides an modern web interface to schedule, manage, and monitor encrypted backups of your remote storage.

form_fields.label: App secret
form_fields.hint: Encrypts repository credentials and other secrets in Zerobyte's database. Generated for you; if you ever move the data folder to a new install, carry this value over or stored credentials cannot be decrypted.

form_fields.label: Allowed webhook origins
form_fields.hint: Optional. Comma-separated origins (scheme, host and port, e.g. https://gotify.example.com) that Zerobyte may call for Gotify, generic webhooks, self-hosted ntfy and backup pre/post webhooks. Public services such as Slack, Discord or ntfy.sh do not need it.
